mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO poem_favorite (user_id, poem_id, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{poemId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM poem_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND poem_id = #{poemId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM poem_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND poem_id = #{poemId}

SELECT m.id AS poemId, m.title, m.subtitle, m.dynasty, m.mood, m.famous_line AS famousLine, m.paragraphs, p.name AS poetName, f.create_time AS favoritedAt FROM poem_favorite f JOIN poem m ON m.id = f.poem_id JOIN poet p ON p.id = m.poet_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC
